title: People Are Highly Cooperative with Large Language Models, Especially When Communication Is Possible or Following Human Interaction
reasoning: The paper investigates how humans apply social and moral norms (specifically cooperation and fairness) to AI. It utilizes the Prisoner's Dilemma—a classic social dilemma—to study prosocial behavior and evaluates specific moral motives such as 'Being fair' versus 'Taking advantage' when interacting with LLMs.
